# SpecimenLog schemas
{: .no_toc}

Entry schemas for specimen logs: measurements followed over time for one specimen set.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## How to use this family

- [`specimenlog`](/api/modules/specimenlog/): `type` selects the type; each log entry added through the entry actions is validated against it.
- Every version is published at `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenLog/<Type>/<version>.json` and never changes; `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenLog/<Type>.json` is the current version and `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenLog/<Type>/` lists the versions. See [Public schemas](/api/public-schemas/).
- Quantities are objects `{"value": <number>, "unit": "<code>"}`. Property paths with `[]` are inside a repeatable list of rows. The server sets the schema version field itself.

## Solution Logs

### Bath solution log

- type code `BathSolution` · version 1.0.2 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenLog/BathSolution/1.0.2.json)

Logs the bath solution applied to a specimen set, such as ACSF, with exchange type, volume, temperature, pH, osmolality, perfusion flow rate, oxygenation gas and the chamber used.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `solutionName` | Solution name or formulation | text |  |  | Identifies the bath solution, such as ACSF or recovery solution. |
| `exchangeType` | Exchange type | choice |  | one of `full`, `partial`, `continuous_perfusion`, `measurement_only` | How the solution was applied or observed. |
| `volume` | Volume exchanged | quantity with unit |  | units `µL`, `mL`, `L`; default `{"unit": "mL"}` | The volume exchanged or added during this log event. |
| `temperature` | Solution temperature | quantity with unit |  | units `°C`, `K`; default `{"unit": "°C"}` | The solution temperature during the recorded exchange or exposure. |
| `ph` | pH | number |  | ≥ 0 and ≤ 14 | The measured pH of the bath solution. |
| `osmolality` | Osmolality | quantity with unit |  | units `mOsm/kg`; default `{"unit": "mOsm/kg"}` | The measured or declared osmolality of the bath solution. |
| `flowRate` | Perfusion flow rate | quantity with unit |  | units `µL/min`, `mL/min`, `L/min`; default `{"unit": "mL/min"}` | The perfusion flow rate during this log event. |
| `oxygenationGas` | Oxygenation gas mixture | text |  |  | Gas composition used to oxygenate the solution, for example 95% O₂ / 5% CO₂. |
| `deviceIdentifier` | Device or chamber identifier | text |  |  | The identifier of the device, chamber, or instrument used for the measurement. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "solutionName": "text",
    "exchangeType": "full"
}
```


### Culture medium change

- type code `CultureMediumChange` · version 1.1.2 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenLog/CultureMediumChange/1.1.2.json)

Logs a change of culture medium, with the replacement medium formulation, volume exchanged and any supplements added.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `mediumFormulation` | Medium formulation | text |  |  | The formulation or product identity of the replacement culture medium. |
| `volume` | Volume changed | quantity with unit |  | units `µL`, `mL`, `L`; default `{"unit": "mL"}` | The volume exchanged or added during this log event. |
| `supplements` | Supplements added | text |  |  | Supplements added to the medium during this change, including concentrations when known. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "mediumFormulation": "text",
    "volume": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "mL"
    }
}
```


## Environmental Logs

### CO₂ log

- type code `CO2` · version 1.0.2 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenLog/CO2/1.0.2.json)

Logs the CO₂ concentration of the incubator atmosphere holding a culture, with the incubator ID.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `co2Percent` | CO₂ (%) | number |  | ≥ 0 and ≤ 100 | The carbon-dioxide concentration in the incubator atmosphere. |
| `incubatorId` | Incubator ID | text |  |  | The laboratory identifier of the incubator used for this culture. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "co2Percent": 1.0,
    "incubatorId": "text"
}
```


### Humidity log

- type code `Humidity` · version 1.0.2 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenLog/Humidity/1.0.2.json)

Logs the relative humidity of the chamber atmosphere holding a culture, with the chamber ID.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `humidityPercent` | Relative humidity (%) | number |  | ≥ 0 and ≤ 100 | The relative humidity of the chamber atmosphere as a percentage. |
| `chamberId` | Chamber ID | text |  |  | The laboratory identifier of the chamber used for this culture. |

Illustrative payload:

```json

    "humidityPercent": 1.0,
    "chamberId": "text"

```


### Oxygenation log

- type code `Oxygenation` · version 1.0.2 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenLog/Oxygenation/1.0.2.json)

Logs oxygenation of a bath or chamber, with the applied gas mixture and flow rate, measured dissolved oxygen or partial pressure, and the measurement method, location, device and calibration.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `gasComposition` | Gas composition | text |  |  | Applied gas mixture, for example 95% O₂ / 5% CO₂. |
| `flowRate` | Gas flow rate | quantity with unit |  | units `mL/min`, `L/min`; default `{"unit": "L/min"}` | The perfusion flow rate during this log event. |
| `dissolvedOxygen` | Dissolved oxygen or partial pressure | quantity with unit |  | units `%`, `mg/L`, `mmHg`; default `{"unit": "%"}` | The dissolved-oxygen concentration or oxygen partial pressure at the measurement location. |
| `measurementMethod` | Measurement method | choice |  | one of `applied_gas_only`, `optical_sensor`, `electrochemical_sensor`, `blood_gas_analyser`, `other` | The instrument or method used to obtain this measurement. |
| `measurementLocation` | Measurement location | text |  |  | The location within the chamber, bath, or specimen where the value was measured. |
| `deviceIdentifier` | Device identifier | text |  |  | The identifier of the device, chamber, or instrument used for the measurement. |
| `calibrationReference` | Calibration reference | text |  |  | Calibration date, certificate, or reference for the oxygen sensor. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "gasComposition": "text",
    "flowRate": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "L/min"
    }
}
```

Logs a pH measurement of a bath, chamber or sample, with measurement temperature, method, location, device and calibration.

| `measurementMethod` | Measurement method | choice |  | one of `electrode`, `indicator_strip`, `calculated`, `other` | The instrument or method used to obtain this measurement. |
| `sampleLocation` | Sample location | text |  |  | The bath, chamber, or sample location from which the pH value was obtained. |
| `deviceIdentifier` | Device identifier | text |  |  | The identifier of the device, chamber, or instrument used for the measurement. |
| `calibrationReference` | Calibration reference | text |  |  | Calibration date, buffers, certificate, or reference for the pH device. |

## Health Logs

### Slice health log

- type code `SliceHealth` · version 1.0.2 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenLog/SliceHealth/1.0.2.json)

Logs an assessment of slice health, with overall rating, assessment method and scoring criteria, observed indicators, estimated viability, the context (e.g., before or after recording) and assessor blinding.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `healthRating` | Overall health rating | choice |  | one of `excellent`, `good`, `fair`, `poor`, `non_viable`, `not_assessed` | Overall assessment using the stated method and scoring scale. |
| `assessmentMethod` | Assessment method | choice |  | one of `visual`, `electrophysiology`, `imaging`, `viability_assay`, `other` | The observation or assay method used to assess slice health. |
| `indicators` | Observed indicators | multi-select |  | one of `normal_appearance`, `torn`, `swollen`, `opaque`, `necrotic`, `contaminated`, `other` | The observed features used to judge slice health. |
| `viabilityPercent` | Estimated viability (%) | number |  | ≥ 0 and ≤ 100 | The estimated viable proportion of the assessed cells or tissue as a percentage. |
| `scoringScale` | Scoring scale or criteria | text |  |  | The scoring scale or decision criteria used for the health assessment. |
| `assessmentContext` | Assessment context | text |  |  | For example recovery, pre-recording, post-recording, or culture day. |
| `assessmentBlinding` | Assessment blinding | choice |  | one of `blinded`, `unblinded`, `unknown` | Whether and how the assessor was blinded during the health assessment. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "healthRating": "excellent",
    "assessmentMethod": "visual"
}
```


### Viability assay

- type code `ViabilityAssay` · version 1.0.2 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenLog/ViabilityAssay/1.0.2.json)

Logs a viability assay on cells or tissue, with the assay type, percent viability and total cell count.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `assayType` | Assay type | text |  |  | The assay or measurement method used to estimate viability. |
| `viabilityPercent` | Viability (%) | number |  | ≥ 0 and ≤ 100 | The estimated viable proportion of the assessed cells or tissue as a percentage. |
| `totalCellCount` | Total cell count | integer |  | ≥ 0 | The total number of cells included in the viability calculation. |
| `notes` | Notes | text |  |  | A concise qualification of the viability assay result. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "assayType": "text",
    "viabilityPercent": 1.0
}
```


## Observation Logs

### Generic observation

- type code `GenericObservation` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenLog/GenericObservation/1.0.0.json)

Logs a free-form observation on a specimen set when no specific log type fits.

This type has no type-specific properties: send an empty object. Everything meaningful is recorded on the record itself or on its material usage rows.
